documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Carraro India Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for FY26, driven by robust growth in agricultural drivelines and construction equipment exports, with revenue from operations growing 25% year-on-year to over INR2,255 crores. EBITDA increased by 33% to INR2,475 million and profit after tax rose by 48% to INR1,306 million, supported by operational leverage, localization, and cost discipline. The company remains confident in achieving revenues of around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY30 while continuing to expand capacity and localization initiatives. Carraro India reported a strong financial performance for FY26 with revenue from operations growing by 25% year-on-year to INR 22,555 million, supported by domestic growth and export traction. EBITDA expanded by 33% year-on-year to INR 2,475 million with margin improving to 10.8%, driven by operating leverage and disciplined cost management.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of achieving revenues of around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: With improving industry sentiment, expanding opportunities across domestic and export markets, and strong execution momentum, we remain confident of achieving revenues of around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY ‘30, exceeding our earlier target.

guidance.claim: The company expects tractor and allied equipment volumes to grow in the low to mid-teens this year.
guidance.quote: Industry outlook continues to be positive with tractor and allied equipment volumes expected to grow in the low to mid-teens this year.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of reaching or exceeding its earlier revenue guidance of INR 3,200 crores and moving close to INR 3,500 crores.
guidance.quote: In view of improving off-highway market sentiment, our strong execution momentum, we are confident of possibly reaching but also exceeding the earlier guidance of INR3,200 crores, and we would be moving close to INR3,500 crore, which will be higher than our earlier target of INR3,200 crore, which we mentioned as EUR350 million at that point in time.

guidance.claim: The company is focusing on a growth rate of 10% to 12% for the next financial year.
guidance.quote: So, 10% to 12% is what we will try to focus on for the next financial year.

guidance.claim: The company is on track to increase raw material localization to 86% to 88% in the next 2 to 3 years.
guidance.quote: Our raw material localization stood at 78%, and we remain on track to increase this to 86% to 88% in the next 2 to 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The management expects the transition from two-wheel drive to four-wheel drive tractors to continue going forward.
demand_outlook.quote: Nevertheless, since Carraro is in the four-wheel drive transition phase, we expect that even though market will moderate, the transition of this two-wheel drive to four-wheel drive remain more than the market growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic construction market is expected to remain at the lower level or come back depending on government investment after subsidies.
demand_outlook.quote: Depending on that, the construction market is expected to come back or remain at the lower level as the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports remained a key growth driver, supported by sustained momentum in construction equipment, particularly TBH and BHL exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports remained a key growth driver, supported by sustained momentum in construction equipment, particularly TBH and BHL exports.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM commentary indicates improving domestic retail traction and sustained demand from rural markets, particularly in the mid to high horsepower segments.
demand_outlook.quote: OEM commentary across the sector also indicates improving domestic retail traction and sustained demand from rural markets, particularly in the mid to high horsepower segments driven by better farm economics, easier financing, and rising mechanization.

demand_outlook.claim: The export market for higher horsepower transmissions is gradually recovering.
demand_outlook.quote: For higher horsepower transmissions, the export market is gradually recovering, which could positively impact transmission offtake for high horsepower tractors in future.

demand_outlook.claim: The GST reduction has accelerated the transition from two-wheel drive to four-wheel drive tractors in the domestic agriculture segment.
demand_outlook.quote: In the domestic agriculture segment, the GST reduction has accelerated the transition from two-wheel drive to four-wheel drive tractors by narrowing the price gap between pre-GST two-wheel drive and post-GST four-wheel drive models.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects the four-wheel drive tractor market share to reach 26% to 27% in 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: And it should reach, if you ask me in ‘27, it should reach to 26%, 27% of the market should be four-wheel drive against the 25% today.

capex_expansion.claim: During FY26, the company deployed approximately INR417 million in capex.
capex_expansion.quote: During FY ‘26, we deployed capex approximately of INR417 million towards new telescopic handler axle production, high-performance transmission programs, incremental manufacturing capacity expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: The management confirmed a capex plan in the range of around INR130 crores for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, we confirm that amount, more on the INR130 crores than INR140 crores, but we will be in that range.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board-approved capex to expand axle capacity to 1,54,160 units is aligned with the strong demand outlook.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board-approved capex to expand axle capacity to 1,54,160 units is aligned with our strong demand outlook and will support future growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved a capex outlay of INR 623 million to expand axle capacity from 1,34,000 units to up to 1,54,000 units over the next 18 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, the board has approved a capex outlay of INR623 million to expand our axle capacity from 1,34,000 units to up to 1,54,000 units over the next 18 months, to be funded through a mix of internal accruals and debt.

capex_expansion.claim: The company deployed INR 304 million during the first nine months of FY 2026 to support new telescopic handler axle production, high-performance range transmission, and incremental capacity additions.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to capex, INR304 million was deployed during 9 months FY 2026 to support new telescopic handler axle production, a high-performance range transmission for agriculture application, and incremental capacity additions for FY '26 sales.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to set up four authorized service centers across India.
capex_expansion.quote: This marks an important milestone in our long-term plan to set up four authorized service centers across India.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved to 10.8% in FY26 compared to 10.2% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins improved to 10.8% in FY ‘26 compared to 10.2% in FY ‘25, despite changes in product mix during the year.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material localization was approximately 78% during FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Raw material localization stood at approximately 78% during FY ‘26 and we remain on track to increase this to nearly 86% to 88% over the next two to three years.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability improved with EBITDA growing 28% year-on-year, supported by operating leverage, disciplined cost management, and execution efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: Profitability improved meaningfully during the period with EBITDA growing 28% year-on-year, supported by operating leverage, disciplined cost management, and execution efficiencies even as product mix remained dynamic across quarters.

margins_costs.claim: The company stands by its commitment of around 100 basis points EBITDA margin improvement year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Having said that, we have given a commitment of 100 points year-on-year. I think more or less we will still stand by it, and we feel we will achieve it.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expansion in Q3 was aided by engineering services revenue, cost savings, pricing progress, and better turnover discounts from suppliers.
margins_costs.quote: And then yes, we have done some progress in terms of cost savings, cost optimization, and also on the pricing front with a couple of customers. And those are pretty much the main differences when we look at the gross margin.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a business nomination for a major OEM for bull gears valued at approximately INR150 million annually starting FY28.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year, we secured a business nomination for a major OEM for bull gears, valued at approximately INR150 million annually starting FY ‘28.

orders_capacity.claim: The company signed an engineering services agreement worth approximately INR175 million with Montra Electric.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year, we signed an engineering services agreement worth approximately INR175 million with Montra Electric for the industrialization and supply of electric transmissions for tractors.

orders_capacity.claim: The plant capacity is operating at nearly 90% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: This expansion is aligned with our strong demand outlook, with the plant capacity operating nearly at about 90% utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales of drive lines to backhoe loader customers in the domestic market grew by approximately 5% during the nine-month period.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales of drive lines to backhoe loader customers in the domestic market grew by approximately 5% during the nine-month period, significantly outperforming the broader market decline of nearly 12%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a 100% market share on non-captive OEMs of backhoe loaders in India.
orders_capacity.quote: Which means that people who don’t manufacture in-house the gearbox and axle, which is only one company, the balance 10 companies which make backhoe loaders are 100% with Carraro for axle and transmission.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of INR6.75 per equity share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: On the dividend front, the Board of Directors has recommended a final dividend of INR6.75 per equity share for FY ‘26, resulting in a payout ratio of approximately 30%, subject to shareholder approval.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital days reduced to 38 days from 45 days in FY25.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital days reduced to 38 days from 45 days in FY ‘25, reflecting tighter working capital management and operational discipline.

capital_allocation.claim: The capacity expansion of INR 623 million will be funded through a mix of internal accruals and debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Additionally, the board has approved a capex outlay of INR623 million to expand our axle capacity from 1,34,000 units to up to 1,54,000 units over the next 18 months, to be funded through a mix of internal accruals and debt.

capital_allocation.claim: The company does not anticipate a further reduction in net debt for FY26-FY27 due to higher total capex.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we do not see, at least at the moment, a further reduction in FY’26-FY’27 of our net debt.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sustained rises in energy prices or supply chain volatility could create production and supply impacts, particularly in H1 FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: Any sustained rise in energy prices or supply chain volatility could lead to some production and supply-related impact, especially in H1 FY ‘27 and potentially extend to H2 if the situation persists longer than anticipated.

risks_headwinds.claim: The gear business remained subdued during the first nine months of FY 2026, with near-term growth likely to remain muted.
risks_headwinds.quote: The gear business remained subdued during 9 months FY 2026. Although near-term growth is likely to remain muted, ongoing initiatives to strengthen the business are expected to drive gradual improvement in the coming quarters.

risks_headwinds.claim: Indirect exports of agriculture drive lines remained relatively soft.
risks_headwinds.quote: While indirect exports of agriculture drive lines remained relatively soft, resilient domestic demand helped sustain our overall volume trajectory.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets increasing raw material localization to nearly 86% to 88%.
management_commitments.quote: Raw material localization stood at approximately 78% during FY ‘26 and we remain on track to increase this to nearly 86% to 88% over the next two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: The Start of Production for the Turkey higher horsepower transmission program is expected during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect SOP, Start of Production, for the Turkey program during FY ‘27, while the Indian customer program is expected to enter production by FY ‘28.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve revenues of around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: With improving industry sentiment, expanding opportunities across domestic and export markets, and strong execution momentum, we remain confident of achieving revenues of around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY ‘30, exceeding our earlier target.

management_commitments.claim: Business nomination for bull gears from a major OEM is valued at approximately ~INR 15 crore p.a. effective FY28.
management_commitments.quote: In the gears business, secured a business nomination from a major OEM for bull gears, valued at approximately ~INR 15 crore p.a. effective FY28.

management_commitments.quote: Our raw material localization stood at 78%, and we remain on track to increase this to 86% to 88% in the next 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.quote: Additionally, the board has approved a capex outlay of INR623 million to expand our axle capacity from 1,34,000 units to up to 1,54,000 units over the next 18 months, to be funded through a mix of internal accruals and debt.

management_commitments.quote: So, 10% to 12% is what we will try to focus on for the next financial year.

management_commitments.quote: Having said that, we have given a commitment of 100 points year-on-year. I think more or less we will still stand by it, and we feel we will achieve it.
